items.note: Three governments published an attack-on-one clause without a trigger definition, a consultation rule or a named command.
Screening every boat reaching the capital rests on a river-port network with no published traffic denominator.
A 14-year-old took a legally registered handgun from home; the prime minister promised a carrying law the same day.
Texas is testing 474 GW of large-load requests against cash deposits rather than against transmission plans.
Typhoon Dolphin closed Naha airport while thousands of Kumamoto residents were still in quake shelters.

items.kicker: A Carrying Law for a Gun Taken at Home
items.what: A 14-year-old killed his grandparents with his grandfather’s registered handgun, then five people at a school in Bang Kruai. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul promised to restrict public carrying, a rule that would not have governed the bedroom the weapon came from. No bill text or legislative calendar had been published by cutoff.

Typhoon Dolphin drew evacuation orders covering nearly 260,000 people, closed Naha airport and halted work at nine Toyota plants. Around 6,700 Kumamoto residents were still in shelters after the previous week’s magnitude-7.1 earthquake, with forecast temperatures near 36°C. Orders are not departures: about 240 people were counted in Okinawa shelters by midday.

The European Commission signed an agreement with the SpaceRISE consortium adding 66 low-Earth-orbit satellites, taking the reported main constellation to 348 with operations targeted for 2029. What the signature does not reveal is whether those spacecraft are a firm production lot, a contract amendment or an option awaiting a later budget. Contract values, workshare and launch slots remain unpublished.

items.kicker: Child Files in Ceuta, Border Checks in Italy
items.what: Spain registered 1,342 unaccompanied minors, converted two schools for reception and gave priority to girls and children under 13, with mainland transfers expected within weeks. Italy kept controls on non-EU travellers arriving from Spain until at least 15 August. Ceuta sits outside the Schengen free-movement area and Italy shares no land border with Spain.

items.kicker: Peru Lets the Defendant Go, Keeps the File
items.what: Lima and Mexico City agreed to restore diplomatic relations, and Peru granted former prime minister Betssy Chávez safe conduct to leave while expressly reserving its right to seek extradition. Mexico keeps the asylum; Peru keeps the claim. Neither country has exchanged ambassadors since early 2023.
